ACCEPT — reviewer of record: PM (epic objectstack-ai/cloud#1841), verified against GitHub.

- PR #7376: draft → main, `Fixes #7255`; files in `views/studio-design/**` + the assistant-bus hook + tests + changeset — inside the surface.
- Ruling check: no new channel, no poll, no reload — the existing assistant-bus `emitMetadataRefresh()` pulse (already fired by ChatPane on authoring envelopes, incl. the confirm-replay path) gains its missing subscriber: `useMetadataRefreshNonce(hold)` in the load deps of the Interfaces (nav tree + object picker), Data, Automations and Access rails; the pulse is HELD while the nav edit buffer is dirty/saving and released, not dropped; no appStatus flap on re-read. Production-safe by construction (nothing near the dev-only SSE #7257 retired). PM's "read it off the tool-card state" guess corrected — accepted.
- Icon half judged producer-side per the ruling and filed as objectstack-ai/cloud#1858 (no consumer-side label guessing) — agreed; renderer defaults already exist.
